thought.text: Path typo on my part — Liquibase home is /opt/liquibase-5.0.4. Retrying with correct paths:

reasoning_content: My mistake: /opt/liquibase doesn't exist. The liquibase home is /opt/liquibase-5.0.4. I'll put the jar in /opt/liquibase-5.0.4/ and adjust the classpath accordingly.

action.command:
cd /opt && cp /workspace/xplan-database/xplan-database-scripts/target/xplan-database-scripts-9.4-SNAPSHOT.jar /opt/liquibase-5.0.4/xplan-database-scripts.jar
export LIQUIBASE_HOME=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4
timeout 300 $LIQUIBASE_HOME/liquibase \
  --driver=org.postgresql.Driver \
  --classpath=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4/xplan-database-scripts.jar:/opt/org/postgresql/postgresql/42.7.3/postgresql-42.7.3.jar \
  --search-path=/opt/liquibase-5.0.4/xplan-database-scripts \
  --changelog-file=changelog_xplandb.yaml \
  --url=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/xplanbox \
  --username=initxplanbox \
  --password=initxplanbox \
  update \
  -Dxplan.db.user=xplanbox \
  -Dxplan.srid=25832 \
  -Dxplan.defaultCrs=EPSG:25832 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "LIQUIBASE EXIT: $?"
